summary: Completed iteration 4 backend and browser regression testing, including monthly calendar rendering, navigation, due-date marker/reminder integration, desktop/mobile layout, auth, task views, navigation, and logout.

critical.issue: Public preview ingress still returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for both the trusted preview origin and https://evil.example, contrary to the explicit credentialed CORS policy.

action_items: Fix the public ingress/preflight layer so untrusted origins are rejected and trusted origins receive an explicit origin; never emit wildcard CORS with credentialed JWT cookies.
Investigate the browser console React markup error reporting a span nested inside an option during member-option rendering; rerun console-clean browser regression after the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: TaskModal comment loading still has no loading/error state, so a persisted comment list can briefly appear empty and fetch failures are silent.
Calendar task markers are rendered as button elements without an onClick action, so the marker affordance does not open the corresponding task for editing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised functional flows; console-clean requirement not met due observed 401 resource logs and React option markup error

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_calendar_iteration4 through the API; created TEST_calendar_ui_marker through the UI and left it because the product has no cleanup flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin@northstar.team / Northstar123!. Calendar passed August 2026 rendering, weekday grid, current-day highlight, previous/next navigation, due marker, sorted reminder integration, and mobile no-overflow. Recheck ingress CORS and console output; existing comment loading race remains from prior iteration.
rca of the issue: External OPTIONS responses are answered or rewritten upstream of FastAPI and return wildcard CORS for trusted and evil origins. The browser markup error originates while dynamically rendering member names/roles inside option elements (the preview instrumentation reports a span child of option); initial unauthenticated auth/me 401s are also logged as failed resources by the browser even though they are expected route-protection behavior.
